title: nexus
description: High-contrast organic and highly creative marketing agency website with tactile clay sculptures, hand-drawn botanical illustrations, and editorial serif typography.

sections.title: Header & Navigation
sections.summary: Minimal serif navigation with active links, responsive mobile sheet with accessible drawer controls, and direct CTA.

sections.title: Hero Stage
sections.summary: Large editorial headline "Marketing that feels human" with animated hand-drawn terracotta flourish underline, tactile 3D clay cluster cutout, illustrated marketer holding a green sprout, animated ink botanical doodles, and circular spinning botanical seals ("Casual Badges" and "Clay-Made Culture").
sections.customCodeReason: Contains interactive 3D/WebGL, procedural canvas, or pinned scroll-scrubbed stage requiring an HtmlEmbed + page footer script.

sections.title: Philosophy / Manifesto
sections.summary: "Good ideas grow on people." Unboxed claim-to-proof metrics (+148% Brand Recall Lift, 94% Multi-Year Partnerships, 100% Hand-Crafted Studio Work), plus interactive principle tabs ("GROW WITH CARE" vs "MADE WITH FEELING") updating living studio notes.

sections.title: Capabilities / Services
sections.summary: Four core disciplines (Brand Strategy & Positioning, Campaign Creative & Storytelling, Social & Editorial Content, Experiences & Websites) featuring bespoke SVG motifs, tilt hover interactions, and expandable "Inspect craft notes" drawers.

sections.title: Process / Cultivation Cycle
sections.summary: Four sequential chapters (Listen, Imagine, Make, Grow) paired with a scroll-driven and clickable growing SVG botanical vine path with milestone indicators and smooth scroll tracking.

sections.title: Selected Work & Case Study Dialog
sections.summary: Filterable case study showcase (Solstice Apothecary, Loom & Meadow, Kith & Kin Roasters) across Brand World, Campaigns, and Experiences, complete with an accessible detailed modal reader.

sections.title: Client Love / Testimonials
sections.summary: Carousel slider with rotating founder quotes, author roles, and tabular note counters.

sections.title: Start a Conversation / Seed Brief
sections.summary: Interactive brief builder allowing clients to select focus areas, enter project details, run live validation, and generate ready-to-send mailto drafts with one-click clipboard copying.

sections.title: Organic Footer
sections.summary: Studio wordmark, copyright notices, and direct navigation links.
